_doc: c02: level offsets in dB for accompanying lines that sit under a melody at the same printed dynamic: [qn_start, qn_end, dB]. score_to_parts.py writes them into vol_db (track volume envelope, 0.5 qn ramps); timbre (CC11) is unchanged. c04: Vc countermelody cuts eased (B #3), Cb cuts with the EQ (B #2), Vln II bars 63-66 (B #4, C #5), Vla and Harp under the flute solo and the harp under the bar 53-56 violins (B #5), Vc at the bar 61 climax (B #1). c04 after the first render: Vln II bar 64 split [216,218,-8]/[218,220,-2] (beats 3-4 measured 9-13 dB under Vla/Vc), Vc [238,250,-3] (was 2 dB under Vln I), Flute 1 [262,270,-2] (3 dB over Vln I in bar 80). c05: first crescendo bars 57-60 (B #1: BCl, Vla, Cb, Hn1, Timp down, Vln I +2), second build-up (B #2: Cl1 -4, Vln I +2), bars 28-30 violas (B #3), final chord violas +4/+7 (B #4), timp bar 52 (B #5), Hn3/Hn4 muted close -4 (B #6).
